items.title: Warren Buffett’s 1991 Playbook Points The Path Forward As Nvidia Reportedly Prepares To Oust Jensen Huang. Buffett Said He Could Forgive Losses, But There Was One Thing He Would Be Ruthless About
items.summary: A board with no chair, no succession plan, and a CEO under fire. When Salomon Brothers hit a similar crisis in 1991, Warren Buffett stepped in with a strict rule. Nvidia's directors may need the same one.

items.title: Nvidia’s Board Is Reportedly Preparing to Oust Jensen Huang. When Intel and McDonald’s Pushed Out CEOs Over Workplace Relationships, Shareholders Got Opposite Results
items.summary: Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Jensen Huang, the Wall Street Journal reported, after a Times report of his relationship with executive Kimberly Powell; Nvidia fell 7.4% after hours to $160.95. When Intel (2018) and McDonald's (2019) pushed out CEOs over relationships with employees, Intel trailed the S&P 500 by 17 points over a year and McDonald's beat it. The difference was a ready successor.
